summary.headline: Additions and Corrections
summary.text: Addenda and corrigenda correcting catalog references, readings, and wording across pages 30–202. Notes identify Azerbeel as Azarkel (al-Zarqālī), discuss Sachl/Sechel/Selech in Greek manuscripts and translations praised by John Camaterus, and restore the reading “dolious” against “logious.”
